Verify every fixed j has r_j(q)->0 as q->infinity, but at target n=q the Bombieri-Lagarias finite-j weight (-1)^(j-1) binom(n,j)/(j-1)! produces aggregate sigma*(-1)^(q-1), hence order-one opposite outcomes for sigma=+1,-1. This falsifies the bare inference from fixed-j cutoff convergence to uniform all-n weighted-tail control; it makes no claim about actual zeta remainders.
